private lemma weight_transport {V U : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype U]

    weight (G.map e.toEmbedding) (fun a=>b (Sym2.map e.symm a))=weight G b := by
  rw [weight_eq,weight_eq,edgeFinset_map,Finset.sum_map]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

  F 0=0 ∧

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

# Executed bounded-table feasibility from the cited flow bound

The test runs the concrete residual algorithm on the literal three-layer
network. It handles zero margins, empty row or column types, and structural
zeros. No bounded-table feasibility oracle is assumed.

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

def feasibleTest (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ) : Bool :=
  decide ((∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j ∧ value (computedFlow r c b)=∑ i,(r i:ℤ))

def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

/-- Unrestricted nonnegative integer tables with the specified margins. -/
abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
def computedFlow (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ) :
    Vertex m n → Vertex m n → ℤ :=
  pull (EdmondsKarpAlgorithm.maxFlow (networkCapacity r c b)
    (vertices m n source) (vertices m n sink))

def upper (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  CellMaximumProgram.maximum (NetworkVertexCode.data r c b,(i.val,j.val))

variable (hEK : PublishedEdmondsKarp.EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1)
  (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
  (hne : ∃ X,Feasible r c b X)

include hEK hne

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

/-- A finite initial segment of an actual shortest-augmentation
execution. It need not already have reached a maximum flow. -/

  p 0=s ∧ p (Fin.last k)=t ∧ Function.Injective p ∧
  ∀ i : Fin k, 0<(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)

/-- An actual saturating augmentation along a shortest residual path.
The bottleneck is positive, bounded by every residual capacity, and
attained by an arc. The displayed update adds it forward and subtracts
it backward on precisely the traversed arcs. -/
structure Selection (G : SimpleGraph V) where

def star (R : Option I → ℤ) (P : Option J → ℤ) : Option I → Option J → ℤ
  | some _,some _ => 0
  | some i,none => R (some i)
  | none,some j => P (some j)
  | none,none => R none-∑ j,P (some j)

inductive Expr where

  | number : ℕ → Expr

def forward (R₀ R₁ : I → ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ)
    (hR : ∀ i,(∑ j,D i j)=(R₁ i:ℤ)-R₀ i)
    (hP : ∀ j,(∑ i,D i j)=(P₁ j:ℤ)-P₀ j) (X : Accepted R₀ P₀ D) :
    Accepted R₁ P₁ (fun i j => -D i j) := by
  refine ⟨translate R₀ R₁ P₀ P₁ D hR hP X,?_⟩
  intro i j
  rw [translate_cast]
  dsimp only
  omega

def backward (R₀ R₁ : I → ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ)
    (hR : ∀ i,(∑ j,D i j)=(R₁ i:ℤ)-R₀ i)
    (hP : ∀ j,(∑ i,D i j)=(P₁ j:ℤ)-P₀ j) (X : Accepted R₁ P₁ (fun i j => -D i j)) :
    Accepted R₀ P₀ D := by
  refine ⟨translate R₁ R₀ P₁ P₀ (fun i j => -D i j)
    (reverse_rows R₀ R₁ D hR) (reverse_columns P₀ P₁ D hP) X,?_⟩
  intro i j
  rw [translate_cast]
  omega

abbrev NatMatrix := List (List ℕ)
def plus (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed := (z.1.1+z.2.1,z.1.2+z.2.2)

  (z.1.1*z.2.1+z.1.2*z.2.2,z.1.1*z.2.2+z.1.2*z.2.1)
def Accepted (R : I → ℕ) (P : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ) :=
  {X : Table R P // ∀ i j,0 ≤ (X.val i j:ℤ)+D i j}

def translate (R₀ R₁ : I → ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ)
    (hR : ∀ i,(∑ j,D i j)=(R₁ i:ℤ)-R₀ i)
    (hP : ∀ j,(∑ i,D i j)=(P₁ j:ℤ)-P₀ j) (X : Accepted R₀ P₀ D) : Table R₁ P₁ := by
  refine ⟨fun i j => ((X.val.val i j:ℤ)+D i j).toNat,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sum]
    simp_rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (X.property _ _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Nat.cast_sum,X.val.property.1,hR]
    ring
  · intro j
    apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sum]
    simp_rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (X.property _ _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Nat.cast_sum,X.val.property.2,hP]
    ring

structure Instance where

  b : I → J → ℕ
  T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)
  hTG : T≤cellGraph small
  hT : T.IsAcyclic
  hmax : ∀ F : SimpleGraph (I⊕J), F≤cellGraph small → F.IsAcyclic →
    MaximumForest.weight F (capacity b)≤MaximumForest.weight T (capacity b)

  d : ℕ
  W : ℕ

  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W
  hX : ∀ i j, 0≤X i j ∧ X i j≤b i j

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)

  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,

    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)

    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

/-- Log-concavity is needed only on the common ambient box. -/
def FiniteCheeger : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : FiniteChain X) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    (∀ S : Finset X,
      κ * min (∑ x ∈ S, C.π x) (∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x) ≤
        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

structure Instance where
  small : I → J → Bool
  b : I → J → ℕ
  T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)
  hTG : T≤cellGraph small
  hT : T.IsAcyclic
  hmax : ∀ F : SimpleGraph (I⊕J), F≤cellGraph small → F.IsAcyclic →
    MaximumForest.weight F (capacity b)≤MaximumForest.weight T (capacity b)
  r : I → ℤ
  c : J → ℤ
  X : I → J → ℤ
  d : ℕ
  W : ℕ
  hd : 1≤d
  hcard : Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J≤d
  hW : 2≤W
  hlarge : ∀ i j, small i j=false → W≤b i j ∧ 1≤b i j
  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W
  hX : ∀ i j, 0≤X i j ∧ X i j≤b i j
  hXr : ∀ i, (∑ j, X i j)=r i
  hXc : ∀ j, (∑ i, X i j)=c j

variable {I J}

def rationalHeight (A : Instance I J) (C : ℕ) : ℕ := 10*C*A.d^2*(A.W+1)

@[reducible] def View (A : Instance I J) := SmallCell A×Bool

noncomputable def binWidth (A : Instance I J) (C : ℝ) : ℝ := 16*C*(A.d:ℝ)^2

@[reducible] def FreeIndex (small : I → J → Bool) (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J))
    (b : I → J → ℕ) := (a : FreeCell small T) → Fin (b a.val.1 a.val.2+1)

def computedCorrection (A : Instance I J) (C a : ℕ) (z : View A → ℕ)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (sigma : ℚ) (f : FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) : ℚ :=
  rationalPopulation A K hK f*
    PowerOfTwoApproximation.approximate (correctionExponent A C a z K hK f) sigma

/-- A deterministic pointwise relative-error guarantee for the actual
rational correction returned on every integer assignment. -/
def small (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) (W : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : Bool :=
  decide (b i j<W)

def cellGraph (small : I → J → Bool) : SimpleGraph (I⊕J) where
  Adj := cellAdj small
  symm := ⟨by intro v w; cases v <;> cases w <;> exact id⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro v; cases v <;> exact id⟩

noncomputable def weight (G : SimpleGraph V) (b : Sym2 V → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, b e

@[reducible] def SmallCell (A : Instance I J) := {a : I×J // A.small a.1 a.2=true}

@[reducible] def FreeCell (small : I → J → Bool) (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)) :=
  {a : I×J // small a.1 a.2=false ∧ ¬T.Adj (.inl a.1) (.inr a.2)}

def rationalPopulation (A : Instance I J) (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (f : FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) : ℚ :=
  (K:ℚ)^dimension A*(integerFiber A K hK (integerBin A K hK f)).card/assignmentCount A

def approximate (beta sigma : ℚ) : ℚ := approximation beta (rootDegree sigma) (depth sigma)

def correctionExponent (A : Instance I J) (C a : ℕ) (z : View A → ℕ)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (f : FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) : ℚ :=
  (gridExponent A C a z (integerBin A K hK f):ℚ)-
    (a:ℚ)/rationalHeight A C*rationalD A C z (rationalIntegerPoint A C f)

def error (A : Instance I J) (s : Settings A) (eta : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  32000*(Fintype.card (Labels A):ℝ)^8*
    ObservableBounds.observableConstant (Fintype.card (Labels A)) ((A.W:ℝ)^2)/
      (((s.N+1:ℕ):ℝ)*eta^2)+
    (s.N:ℝ)*((6*(s.xi:ℝ)+1/(2:ℝ)^s.k)/2)+
      2*(1/(2:ℝ)^s.h+(j:ℝ)*((restartTime A s.H s.L:ℝ)*
        ((20*(Fintype.card (Labels A):ℝ)^2)/(s.n:ℝ)+
          ((s.n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*((6*(s.xi:ℝ)+1/(2:ℝ)^s.k)/2))))+
        2*((s.N+1:ℕ):ℝ)*(s.xi:ℝ)

def correction (A : Instance I J) (C a : ℝ) (z : View A → ℕ)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (f : FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) : ℝ :=
  ((K:ℝ)^dimension A*(integerFiber A K hK (integerBin A K hK f)).card/assignmentCount A)*
    rho A C a z (integerPoint A C f)/gridWeight A C a z (integerBin A K hK f)

/-- Population correction cancels the bin size and bin weight exactly,
before taking any expectation or approximation. -/
def cellAdj (small : I → J → Bool) : I⊕J → I⊕J → Prop
  | .inl i,.inr j => small i j=false
  | .inr j,.inl i => small i j=false
  | _,_ => False

def w : Expr := .input 1
noncomputable abbrev dimension (A : Instance I J) := Fintype.card (FreeCell A.small A.T)

def integerFiber (A : Instance I J) (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (v : Grid (I := Fin (dimension A)) K) : Finset (FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun f => integerBin A K hK f=v)

def integerBin (A : Instance I J) (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (f : FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) : Grid (I := Fin (dimension A)) K := fun i =>
  let t := index A i
  ⟨(FairBits.scale K (A.b t.val.1 t.val.2+1) (f t).val:ℤ),by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · have hh := FairBits.scale_lt hK (Nat.succ_pos _) (f t).isLt
      have hhZ : (FairBits.scale K (A.b t.val.1 t.val.2+1) (f t).val:ℤ)<K := by
        exact_mod_cast hh
      omega⟩

def assignmentCount (A : Instance I J) : ℕ := Fintype.card (FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b)

def approximation (beta : ℚ) (s n : ℕ) : ℚ := midpoint ((2:ℚ)^numerator beta s) s n

def rootDegree (sigma : ℚ) : ℕ := ⌈128/sigma⌉₊

def depth (sigma : ℚ) : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 (rootDegree sigma)

def gridExponent (A : Instance I J) (C a : ℕ) (z : View A → ℕ)

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

def Feasible (X : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) : Prop := HasMargins X r c ∧ ∀ i j,X i j≤b i j

def modelWidth (hEK : PublishedEdmondsKarp.EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1)
    (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (hne : ∃ X,TableTightening.Feasible r c b X) (epsilon : ℚ) (he : 0 < epsilon) (delta : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  repetitionCount delta*RootedEstimatorLayoutProgram.wordWidth (modelContext hEK r c b hne epsilon he)

def depth (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) (epsilon : ℚ) : ℕ :=

    (innerTolerance (((epsilon/2)/2)/2) (ComputedCountingParameters.phases r c b epsilon)))

def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)

  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.

of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

  reachable v := by

    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

  induction p with

  | read p ih => exact ⟨ih false hp.1 hq.1,ih true hp.2 hq.2⟩
  | delay n p ih => exact ih hp hq

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=

    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

def SameLaw (f : X → Z) (g : Y → Z) : Prop :=

/-- The computed preprocessing and schedule satisfy every input of the
proved adaptive-history theorem. There is no supplied forest, baseline,
endpoint table, or oracle-error assumption in this statement. -/
abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

    (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (hne : ∃ X,TableTightening.Feasible r c b X) (W : ℕ) (hW : 2≤W) :
    Instance (Fin m) (Fin n) where
  small:=ComputedLargeForest.small (newBounds r c b) W
  b:=newBounds r c b
  T:=ComputedLargeForest.computed (newRows r c b) (newColumns r c b) (newBounds r c b) W
  hTG:=(ComputedLargeForest.computed_spec _ _ _ W (by omega)).1
  hT:=(ComputedLargeForest.computed_spec _ _ _ W (by omega)).2.1
  hmax:=(ComputedLargeForest.computed_spec _ _ _ W (by omega)).2.2
  r:=fun i=>(newRows r c b i:ℤ)
  c:=fun j=>(newColumns r c b j:ℤ)
  X:=fun i j=>(baseline r c b i j:ℤ)
  d:=1+m*n

  hW:=hW
  hlarge:=by
    intro i j hs

    exact ⟨Nat.cast_nonneg _,by exact_mod_cast (baseline_properties hEK r c b hne).2 i j⟩
  hXr:=by
    intro i

    intro j

  toFun x := ⟨FairBits.endpoint K N beta+x.val,by
    rw [FairBits.fiber_eq_interval hK hN hb,Finset.mem_Ico]
    have hh := x.isLt
    unfold intervalSize at hh
    omega⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val-FairBits.endpoint K N beta,by
    have hx : FairBits.endpoint K N beta ≤ x.val ∧

      simpa only [FairBits.fiber_eq_interval hK hN hb,Finset.mem_Ico] using x.property
    unfold intervalSize
    omega⟩
  left_inv x := by apply Fin.ext; simp
  right_inv x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hx : FairBits.endpoint K N beta ≤ x.val ∧

  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧

    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-

  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →

    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →

noncomputable def physicalWeight (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)) (b : I → J → ℕ) (ell : I → J → ℤ)
    (M : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℤ) (c : J → ℤ) (alpha : ℝ) :
    (((I×J)×Bool) → ℕ) → ℝ :=
  exactWeight cellLine (rootFlag T) (fun _ => alpha) (lineOffset ell M r c) viewSlope
    (unaryRate T b alpha) (unaryEll ell) unarySlope (unaryCap b)

private lemma line_product_eq (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)) (ell : I → J → ℤ)
    (M : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℤ) (c : J → ℤ) (alpha : ℝ)
    (z : ((I×J)×Bool) → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ g, rootFlag T g=false → deviation ell M r c z g=0) :
    (∏ g, exactLineFactor (rootFlag T) (fun _ => alpha) (lineOffset ell M r c)
      viewSlope g (lineTotal cellLine z g))=(2:ℝ)^(-alpha*rootPenalty T ell M r c z) := by
  have hp : ∀ g, exactLineFactor (rootFlag T) (fun _ => alpha) (lineOffset ell M r c)
      viewSlope g (lineTotal cellLine z g)=
      (2:ℝ)^(-alpha*(if rootFlag T g then |deviation ell M r c z g| else 0)) := by
    intro g
    simp only [exactLineFactor,factor,line_affine]
    cases hg : rootFlag T g
    · simp [h g hg]
    · simp
  simp_rw [hp]
  rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
  congr 1
  simp only [rootPenalty,Finset.mul_sum]

private lemma unary_product_eq (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)) (b : I → J → ℕ)
    (ell : I → J → ℤ) (alpha : ℝ) (z : ((I×J)×Bool) → ℕ) :
    (∏ a, unaryFactor (unaryRate T b alpha) (unaryEll ell) unarySlope (unaryCap b) a (z a))=
      (2:ℝ)^(-alpha*treePenalty T b ell z) := by
  unfold unaryFactor factor
  rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
  congr 1
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [unaryRate,unaryEll,unarySlope,unaryCap,Fintype.sum_bool,Bool.true_eq_false,
    false_and,ite_false,zero_mul,neg_zero,zero_add,true_and]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [treePenalty,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  split_ifs <;> simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_zero] <;> ring

    |actualDeviation small T b x y free r c tree v| else 0)+

def bindLaw (p : RationalLaw α) (K : α → RationalLaw β) : RationalLaw β where

  nonnegative := fun y => Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => mul_nonneg (p.nonnegative x) ((K x).nonnegative y)
  total := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]

    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →

# Bounded shortest-path labels for Edmonds--Karp

An unreachable vertex has label n. Reachable vertices have their actual
shortest distance, at most n-1. These labels are obtained from the already
proved breadth-first search, independently of its deterministic tie rule.

abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def p : Expr := .input 0
def ResidualPath {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (f : Flow n) (s t : Fin n)
    (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) : Prop :=
  p 0=s ∧ p (Fin.last k)=t ∧ Function.Injective p ∧
  ∀ i : Fin k, 0<(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)

/-- An actual saturating augmentation along a shortest residual path.
The bottleneck is positive, bounded by every residual capacity, and
attained by an arc. The displayed update adds it forward and subtracts
it backward on precisely the traversed arcs. -/
def label (c : Capacity n) (f : Flow n) (s v : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  distance (ResidualSearch.edge c f) s v

def upper (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  CellMaximumProgram.maximum (NetworkVertexCode.data r c b,(i.val,j.val))

def forward (R₀ R₁ : I → ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ)
    (hR : ∀ i,(∑ j,D i j)=(R₁ i:ℤ)-R₀ i)
    (hP : ∀ j,(∑ i,D i j)=(P₁ j:ℤ)-P₀ j) (X : Accepted R₀ P₀ D) :
    Accepted R₁ P₁ (fun i j => -D i j) := by
  refine ⟨translate R₀ R₁ P₀ P₁ D hR hP X,?_⟩
  intro i j
  rw [translate_cast]
  dsimp only
  omega

def backward (R₀ R₁ : I → ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ)
    (hR : ∀ i,(∑ j,D i j)=(R₁ i:ℤ)-R₀ i)
    (hP : ∀ j,(∑ i,D i j)=(P₁ j:ℤ)-P₀ j) (X : Accepted R₁ P₁ (fun i j => -D i j)) :
    Accepted R₀ P₀ D := by
  refine ⟨translate R₁ R₀ P₁ P₀ (fun i j => -D i j)
    (reverse_rows R₀ R₁ D hR) (reverse_columns P₀ P₁ D hP) X,?_⟩
  intro i j
  rw [translate_cast]
  omega

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=

def translate (R₀ R₁ : I → ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : J → ℕ) (D : I → J → ℤ)
    (hR : ∀ i,(∑ j,D i j)=(R₁ i:ℤ)-R₀ i)
    (hP : ∀ j,(∑ i,D i j)=(P₁ j:ℤ)-P₀ j) (X : Accepted R₀ P₀ D) : Table R₁ P₁ := by
  refine ⟨fun i j => ((X.val.val i j:ℤ)+D i j).toNat,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sum]
    simp_rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (X.property _ _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Nat.cast_sum,X.val.property.1,hR]
    ring
  · intro j
    apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sum]
    simp_rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (X.property _ _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Nat.cast_sum,X.val.property.2,hP]
    ring

def Selection.map {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (S : Selection G) (e : G ≃g H) : Selection H where
  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

def round (E : Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (P : Paths n) (v : Fin n) :
    Option (List (Fin n)) :=

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

  refine ⟨fun i j => ((X.val.val i j:ℤ)+D i j).toNat,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sum]
    simp_rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (X.property _ _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Nat.cast_sum,X.val.property.1,hR]
    ring
  · intro j
    apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sum]

    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Nat.cast_sum,X.val.property.2,hP]

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

noncomputable abbrev stateCapacity (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : I → J → ℕ :=

abbrev Profiles (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) :=

    (z : SmallView (fun a : I×J => small a.1 a.2) → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : PhysicalAssignments (fun a : I×J => small a.1 a.2) (fun a => B a.1 a.2),

/-- Thus the large set is exactly the complete large-margin rectangle. -/
noncomputable def paperCapacity (small : I → J → Bool) (r : I → ℕ) (d L U : ℕ) : I → J → ℕ :=

the count equivalence follows just from the dimension allowance. -/
def denseDrawBits (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (d : ℕ)

  (d ^ 4 * (h + 1)) * denseTrialBits R P d e h

  hardWeight cellLine (smallCoordinate small)

def Balanced (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) (z : SmallProfile small) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, smallView small z false i j=smallQ small B z i j

def SingleDefect (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) (z : SmallProfile small) : Prop :=
  ∃ s t : I×J, small s.1 s.2=true ∧ small t.1 t.2=true ∧
    IsDefect (smallView small z false) (smallQ small B z) s t

@[reducible] def LargeCell (small : C → Bool) := {c : C // small c=false}

/-- This is the actual partition of doubled cells into small views and
large pairs. -/
noncomputable def hardWeight (line : C → G) (inner : C → Bool)

  if penalty line inner offset slope smallOffset smallSlope z=0 then 1 else 0

def cellLine (u : (I × J) × Bool) : I ⊕ J := if u.2 then .inr u.1.2 else .inl u.1.1

def smallCoordinate (small : I → J → Bool) (u : (I × J) × Bool) : Bool := small u.1.1 u.1.2

noncomputable def fullOffset (B : I → J → ℕ) (rbar : I → ℕ) (cbar : J → ℕ) : I ⊕ J → ℝ :=
  Sum.elim (fun i => -(rbar i:ℝ)) (fun j => (columnCapacity B j:ℝ)-cbar j)

noncomputable def rowLargeCount (small : I → J → Bool) (i : I) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j, if small i j then 0 else 1

noncomputable def columnLargeCount (small : I → J → Bool) (j : J) : ℕ :=
  ∑ i, if small i j then 0 else 1

def viewSlope : I ⊕ J → ℝ := Sum.elim (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => -1)

noncomputable def smallOffset (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ)
    (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : I ⊕ J → ℝ :=
  Sum.elim (fun i => -(r i:ℝ)) (fun j => (smallColumnCapacity small B j:ℝ)-c j)

def retainedTest (z : Input×(ℕ×ℕ)) : Bool := decide (entry z<z.1.2)

def denseStepBits (d : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 (8 * d) + 8 * d ^ 5

def offsetBitLength (w h d : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 (w + 1) + 4 * (h + d)

/-- This law is the exact output law of multiplying the finite fair-bit
integer by w and taking the integer quotient. -/
def integerWidth (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (p : I × J) : ℕ :=
  min (R (some p.1)) (P (some p.2)) / d ^ 8

noncomputable def smallView (small : I → J → Bool)

  if hs : small i j=true then z (⟨(i,j),hs⟩,v) else 0

exactly as used by the manuscript's supported residual completion sum. -/
noncomputable def smallQ (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ)
    (z : SmallProfile small) (i : I) (j : J) : ℕ :=
  if hs : small i j=true then B i j-z (⟨(i,j),hs⟩,true) else 0

private lemma normalized_base_bound (b l s : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hl : l ≤ 2^b) (hs : s+1 ≤ 2^(4*b)) : l*s+1 ≤ 2^(6*b) := by
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul hl (show s ≤ 2^(4*b) by omega)
  have he : (2:ℕ)^b*2^(4*b)=2^(5*b) := by
    calc
      _ = 2^(b+4*b) := (pow_add 2 b (4*b)).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (2:ℕ)^k) (by omega)
  rw [he] at hm
  have hp : 1 ≤ (2:ℕ)^(5*b) := one_le_pow₀ (by decide)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*2^(5*b) := by omega
    _ = 2^(5*b+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; omega
    _ ≤ 2^(6*b) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)

  reachable v := by

    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

    (coefficient r c b epsilon) (binCount r c b epsilon) (phases r c b epsilon)
    (capacityBits r c b) (binCount_pos r c b epsilon he) (cutoff_eq hEK r c b hne epsilon he).ge
    (epsilon/2) (start hEK r c b hne epsilon he)

abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

execution. It need not already have reached a maximum flow. -/

def paddedMarginAtRealizer (row : Bool) : Realizer (paddedMarginAt row) := by
  let arg : Realizer (fun z : PaddingData×ℕ => (z.1.1,z.2)) :=
    pair (composition first first) second
  let value := composition arg (marginValueRealizer row)
  let used := composition arg (lineValueRealizer row)
  let threshold : Realizer (fun z : PaddingData×ℕ => z.1.1.2) :=
    composition (composition first first) second
  let pad : Realizer (fun z : PaddingData×ℕ => z.1.2) := composition first second
  let flag := composition (pair threshold value) largeFlagRealizer
  let count := composition (pair threshold
    (composition (composition first first) (marginListRealizer (!row)))) largeCountRealizer
  let amount := composition (pair (composition (pair flag count) multiply) pad) multiply
  let remain := composition (pair value used) subtract
  let result := composition (pair remain amount) add
  exact result

def paddedMarginAt (row : Bool) (z : PaddingData×ℕ) : ℕ :=
  let a := (marginList row z.1.1).getD z.2 0
  let used := lineSum row (lineArgument row (z.1.1,z.2))
  a-used+largeFlag (z.1.1.2,a)*largeCount (z.1.1.2,marginList (!row) z.1.1)*z.1.2

finite arithmetic and have no published-input hypotheses.

    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →

    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

Cells follow `cellEnum`, their copies follow increasing finite indices,
and each copy contributes its false and true coordinates consecutively.
The polynomial initializer computes exactly this encoding of the actual

structure Instance where
  small : I → J → Bool
  b : I → J → ℕ
  T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)
  hTG : T≤cellGraph small
  hT : T.IsAcyclic
  hmax : ∀ F : SimpleGraph (I⊕J), F≤cellGraph small → F.IsAcyclic →
    MaximumForest.weight F (capacity b)≤MaximumForest.weight T (capacity b)
  r : I → ℤ
  c : J → ℤ
  X : I → J → ℤ
  d : ℕ
  W : ℕ
  hd : 1≤d
  hcard : Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J≤d
  hW : 2≤W
  hlarge : ∀ i j, small i j=false → W≤b i j ∧ 1≤b i j
  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W
  hX : ∀ i j, 0≤X i j ∧ X i j≤b i j
  hXr : ∀ i, (∑ j, X i j)=r i
  hXc : ∀ j, (∑ i, X i j)=c j

variable {I J}

def initialBits (A : Instance I J) (B : ℕ) : ℕ := bitCount (cellCapacity A) B

def pairEquiv (A : Instance I J) : (Labels A×Bool) ≃ (Copy (cellCapacity A)×Bool) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (copyEquiv A) (Equiv.refl Bool)

def cellCapacity (A : Instance I J) (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SmallCell A))) : ℕ :=
  A.b ((cellEnum A).symm i).val.1 ((cellEnum A).symm i).val.2

def drawChoices (b : Fin q → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (bits : Fin (bitCount b B) → Bool) :
    ∀ i,Finset (Fin (b i)) :=
  fun i => subsetDraw B (b i) (wordEquiv b B bits i)

def small (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) (W : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : Bool :=
  decide (b i j<W)

def cellGraph (small : I → J → Bool) : SimpleGraph (I⊕J) where
  Adj := cellAdj small
  symm := ⟨by intro v w; cases v <;> cases w <;> exact id⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro v; cases v <;> exact id⟩

noncomputable def weight (G : SimpleGraph V) (b : Sym2 V → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, b e

@[reducible] def Labels (A : Instance I J) := Σ s : SmallCell A, Fin (A.b s.val.1 s.val.2)

abbrev Copy := Σ c, Fin (b c)

def copyEquiv (A : Instance I J) : Labels A ≃ Copy (cellCapacity A) :=
  Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft' (cellEnum A)

@[reducible] def SmallCell (A : Instance I J) := {a : I×J // A.small a.1 a.2=true}

def cellEnum (A : Instance I J) : SmallCell A ≃ Fin (Fintype.card (SmallCell A)) :=
  Fintype.equivFin (SmallCell A)

def bitCount (b : Fin q → ℕ) (B : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ i,drawBits B (b i)

def subsetDraw (B n : ℕ) (bits : Fin (drawBits B n) → Bool) : Finset (Fin n) :=
  subsetEquiv n (vectorDraw B n bits)

def wordEquiv (b : Fin q → ℕ) (B : ℕ) :
    (Fin (bitCount b B) → Bool) ≃ (∀ i,Fin (drawBits B (b i)) → Bool) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr finSigmaFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl Bool)).trans
    (Equiv.piCurry (fun _ _ => Bool))

def cellAdj (small : I → J → Bool) : I⊕J → I⊕J → Prop
  | .inl i,.inr j => small i j=false
  | .inr j,.inl i => small i j=false
  | _,_ => False

def w : Expr := .input 1
def drawBits (B n : ℕ) := B+n*B

def subsetEquiv (n : ℕ) : (Fin n → Bool) ≃ Finset (Fin n) where
  toFun v := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => v i=true)
  invFun S i := decide (i∈S)
  left_inv v := by
    funext i
    cases h : v i <;> simp [h]
  right_inv S := by ext i; simp

def vectorDraw (B n : ℕ) (bits : Fin (drawBits B n) → Bool) : Fin n → Bool :=
  let words := splitWordEquiv B (n*B) bits
  bitDraw B n (scaledBitInteger (n+1) B (Nat.succ_pos n) words.1).val words.2

inductive Expr where
  | input : ℕ → Expr
  | number : ℕ → Expr
  | plus : Expr → Expr → Expr
  | times : Expr → Expr → Expr

def splitWordEquiv (k l : ℕ) : (Fin (k + l) → Bool) ≃ ((Fin k → Bool) × (Fin l → Bool)) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr finSumFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl Bool)).trans
    (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow _ _ _)

def bitDraw (B n k : ℕ) (bits : Fin (n*B) → Bool) : Fin n → Bool :=
  draw B n k (blockWords n B bits)

def scaledBitInteger (M k : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (bits : Fin k → Bool) : Fin M :=
  scaledInteger M k hM (binaryWordEquiv k bits)

/-- The exact law of the finite Boolean quotient operation is the law
used in the dense offset error estimate and the tabulation formula. -/
def plus (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed := (z.1.1+z.2.1,z.1.2+z.2.2)
def times (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed :=
  (z.1.1*z.2.1+z.1.2*z.2.2,z.1.1*z.2.2+z.1.2*z.2.1)
def draw (B : ℕ) : (n k : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin B → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool)
  | 0, _, _ => fun i => Fin.elim0 i
  | n+1, k, words =>
      let b := headDraw B n k (words 0)
      Fin.cons b (draw B n (remaining n k b) (Fin.tail words))

private theorem consWordLaw {W V : Type*} [Fintype W] [Fintype V]
    [Nonempty W] [Nonempty V] {n : ℕ} (f : W → Bool)
    (g : Bool → V → (Fin n → Bool)) :
    mapLaw (productLaw (uniformLaw (α := W)) (uniformLaw (α := V)))
      (fun ab => Fin.cons (f ab.1) (g (f ab.1) ab.2))=
    consLaw (mapLaw (uniformLaw (α := W)) f)
      (fun b => mapLaw (uniformLaw (α := V)) (g b)) := by
  change mapLaw _ (fun ab : W×V => consEquiv n (⟨f ab.1,g (f ab.1) ab.2⟩ :
    (_b : Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)))=_
  rw [mapLaw_equiv_output,mapLaw_dependent_product]
  rfl

def blockWords (n B : ℕ) : (Fin (n*B) → Bool) ≃ (Fin n → Fin B → Bool) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr finProdFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl Bool)).trans (Equiv.curry _ _ _)

def scaledInteger (M k : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (z : Fin (2 ^ k)) : Fin M :=
  ⟨M * z.val / 2 ^ k, by
    rw [← scale_eq_div]
    exact scale_lt hM (pow_pos (by decide) k) z.isLt⟩

def binaryWordEquiv (k : ℕ) : (Fin k → Bool) ≃ Fin (2 ^ k) :=
  (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Fin k => finTwoEquiv.symm)).trans finFunctionFinEquiv

def error (A : Instance I J) (s : Settings A) (eta : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  32000*(Fintype.card (Labels A):ℝ)^8*
    ObservableBounds.observableConstant (Fintype.card (Labels A)) ((A.W:ℝ)^2)/
      (((s.N+1:ℕ):ℝ)*eta^2)+
    (s.N:ℝ)*((6*(s.xi:ℝ)+1/(2:ℝ)^s.k)/2)+
      2*(1/(2:ℝ)^s.h+(j:ℝ)*((restartTime A s.H s.L:ℝ)*
        ((20*(Fintype.card (Labels A):ℝ)^2)/(s.n:ℝ)+
          ((s.n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*((6*(s.xi:ℝ)+1/(2:ℝ)^s.k)/2))))+
        2*((s.N+1:ℕ):ℝ)*(s.xi:ℝ)

abbrev Signed := ℕ×ℕ

def headDraw (B n k : ℕ) (bits : Fin B → Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (rationalThresholdAccept B (headProbability n k) bits)

def mapLaw [DecidableEq β] (p : RationalLaw α) (f : α → β) : RationalLaw β where
  mass := fun y => ∑ x, if f x = y then p.mass x else 0
  nonnegative := fun y => Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => by
    split_ifs
    · exact p.nonnegative x
    · rfl
  total := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simpa using p.total

omit [Nonempty α] in
/-- Deterministic postprocessing contracts total variation, as used for
the map selecting the first successful trial and unpadding its table. -/
def productLaw (p : RationalLaw α) (q : RationalLaw β) : RationalLaw (α × β) where
  mass := fun z => p.mass z.1 * q.mass z.2
  nonnegative := fun z => mul_nonneg (p.nonnegative z.1) (q.nonnegative z.2)
  total := by
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← Finset.mul_sum, q.total, mul_one, p.total]

omit [Nonempty α] in
/-- Independent trials accumulate their errors additively, before the
deterministic first-success map is applied. -/
def uniformLaw : RationalLaw α where
  mass := fun _ => uniformMass (α := α)
  nonnegative := fun _ => uniformMass_pos.le
  total := uniformMass_total

omit [Nonempty α] in
/-- Successful stationary pairs have equal mass; the repeated-trial law
is exactly a uniform law mixed with the fallback, without conditioning on
the implemented approximate trial's success. -/
def consLaw {n : ℕ} (p : RationalLaw Bool) (Q : Bool → RationalLaw (Fin n → Bool)) :
    RationalLaw (Fin (n+1) → Bool) :=
  equivLaw (consEquiv n) (dependentJointLaw p Q)

def consEquiv (n : ℕ) : ((_b : Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)) ≃ (Fin (n+1) → Bool) where
  toFun x := Fin.cons x.1 x.2
  invFun v := ⟨v 0,Fin.tail v⟩
  left_inv x := by cases x; simp
  right_inv v := Fin.cons_self_tail v

structure Settings (A : Instance I J) where
  C : ℕ
  K : ℕ

  L : ℕ
  k : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  N : ℕ
  h : ℕ
  hK : 1 ≤ K
  hW : 100*A.d*K ≤ A.W
  xi : ℚ
  v : Grid (I := Fin (dimension A)) K

def observableConstant (p q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  10*p^4*(9*(p*(1+8*p*q^2))+2*(8+32*p*q^3))

abbrev rationalThresholdAccept (k : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (bits : Fin k → Bool) : Prop :=
  (binaryWordEquiv k bits).val < rationalThreshold k q

def headProbability (n k : ℕ) : ℚ := ((min k (n+1):ℕ):ℚ)/(n+1)

def p : Expr := .input 0
structure RationalLaw (α : Type*) [Fintype α] where
  mass : α → ℚ
  nonnegative : ∀ x, 0 ≤ mass x
  total : ∑ x, mass x = 1

variable [Nonempty α]

def mass (S : Finset X) : ℝ := ∑ x ∈ S, C.π x
def x : Expr := .input 0
def variation (p q : RationalLaw α) : ℚ :=
  (∑ x, |p.mass x - q.mass x|) / 2

declarations.moduleDocumentation:
# Executed bottleneck and residual augmentation

The program takes the actual BFS path list, scans its residual capacities
for a minimum, and adds the resulting skew path flow. No path or amount
is chosen through a mathematical existence proof.
declarations.retrievalContext:
abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def step (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Option (Flow n) :=
  (ResidualSearch.search c f s t).map (fun xs=>listUpdate f xs (bottleneck c f xs))

def IsMaximum {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  Feasible c s t f ∧ ∀ g, Feasible c s t g → value s g≤value s f

/-- A directed residual path with k arcs and no repeated vertices. -/
def upper (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  CellMaximumProgram.maximum (NetworkVertexCode.data r c b,(i.val,j.val))

variable (hEK : PublishedEdmondsKarp.EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1)
  (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
  (hne : ∃ X,Feasible r c b X)

include hEK hne

def search (c : Capacity n) (f : Flow n) (s t : Fin n) : Option (List (Fin n)) :=
  paths (edge c f) s n t

def Selection.map {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (S : Selection G) (e : G ≃g H) : Selection H where
  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

/-- The concrete row-then-column vertex order of the contingency graph. -/
def listUpdate (f : Flow n) (xs : List (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) : Flow n :=
  fun u v=>f u v+a*((((arcs xs).map (fun uv=>if uv=(u,v) then (1:ℤ) else 0)).sum)-
    (((arcs xs).map (fun uv=>if uv=(v,u) then (1:ℤ) else 0)).sum))

def bottleneck (c : Capacity n) (f : Flow n) (xs : List (Fin n)) : ℤ :=
  ((arcs xs).map (fun uv=>(c uv.1 uv.2:ℤ)-f uv.1 uv.2)).min?.getD 0

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def value {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : ℤ := ∑ v, f s v

noncomputable def path {G : SimpleGraph V} (S : Selection G) (v : V) : G.Walk v (S.root v) :=
  Classical.choice (S.reachable v)

variable [Fintype V]

def arcs : List (Fin n) → List (Fin n×Fin n)
  | [] => []
  | [_] => []
  | u::v::xs => (u,v)::arcs (v::xs)

def maximum (z : Context) : ℕ := BinarySearchProgram.search test (z,bound z)

def data (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) : Input :=
  ((List.ofFn r,List.ofFn c),natCode b)

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

def paths (E : Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (s : Fin n) : ℕ → Paths n
  | 0 => fun v=>if v=s then some [s] else none
  | k+1 => round E (paths E s k)

def edge (c : Capacity n) (f : Flow n) (u v : Fin n) : Bool :=
  decide (0<(c u v:ℤ)-f u v)

structure Selection (G : SimpleGraph V) where
  root : V → V
  reachable : ∀ v,G.Reachable v (root v)
  constant : ∀ {u v},G.Reachable u v → root u=root v

def column (j : Fin n) : Vertex m n := Sum.inr (Sum.inr j)

def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
abbrev Paths (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Option (List (Fin n))

def round (E : Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (P : Paths n) (v : Fin n) :
    Option (List (Fin n)) :=
  match P v with
  | some xs => some xs
  | none => (predecessor E P v).bind (fun u=>(P u).map (fun xs=>xs++[v]))

abbrev Vertex (m n : ℕ) := Bool ⊕ (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)

variable {m n : ℕ}

abbrev Signed := ℕ×ℕ

def execute (z : A×ℕ) : State A :=
  (steps z).foldl (fun s i=>advance test (i,s)) (z.1,(0,z.2))

def capacityEntry (z : NatMatrix×(ℕ×ℕ)) : ℕ :=
  (z.1.getD z.2.1 []).getD z.2.2 0

abbrev NatMatrix := List (List ℕ)
def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

def Feasible (X : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) : Prop := HasMargins X r c ∧ ∀ i j,X i j≤b i j

noncomputable def instanceData (hEK : PublishedEdmondsKarp.EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1)
    (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (hne : ∃ X,TableTightening.Feasible r c b X) (W : ℕ) (hW : 2≤W) :
    Instance (Fin m) (Fin n) where
  small:=ComputedLargeForest.small (newBounds r c b) W
  b:=newBounds r c b
  T:=ComputedLargeForest.computed (newRows r c b) (newColumns r c b) (newBounds r c b) W
  hTG:=(ComputedLargeForest.computed_spec _ _ _ W (by omega)).1
  hT:=(ComputedLargeForest.computed_spec _ _ _ W (by omega)).2.1
  hmax:=(ComputedLargeForest.computed_spec _ _ _ W (by omega)).2.2
  r:=fun i=>(newRows r c b i:ℤ)
  c:=fun j=>(newColumns r c b j:ℤ)
  X:=fun i j=>(baseline r c b i j:ℤ)
  d:=1+m*n
  W:=W
  hd:=by omega
  hcard:=by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]; omega
  hW:=hW
  hlarge:=by
    intro i j hs
    have hb : W≤newBounds r c b i j := by
      simpa only [ComputedLargeForest.small,decide_eq_false_iff_not,not_lt] using hs
    exact ⟨hb,(show 1≤W by omega).trans hb⟩
  hsmall:=by
    intro i j hs
    simpa only [ComputedLargeForest.small,decide_eq_true_eq] using hs
  hX:=by
    intro i j
    exact ⟨Nat.cast_nonneg _,by exact_mod_cast (baseline_properties hEK r c b hne).2 i j⟩
  hXr:=by
    intro i
    exact_mod_cast (baseline_properties hEK r c b hne).1.1 i
  hXc:=by
    intro j
    exact_mod_cast (baseline_properties hEK r c b hne).1.2 j

/-- Tightening preserves the count consumed by the terminal estimator. -/
abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

/-- Unrestricted nonnegative integer tables with the specified margins. -/
abbrev NatMatrix := List (List ℕ)
def output (z : Input) : NatMatrix := table (prepare z)
def compute (z : Input) : Input := translate (prepare z)
structure Instance where
  small : I → J → Bool
  b : I → J → ℕ
  T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)
  hTG : T≤cellGraph small
  hT : T.IsAcyclic
  hmax : ∀ F : SimpleGraph (I⊕J), F≤cellGraph small → F.IsAcyclic →
    MaximumForest.weight F (capacity b)≤MaximumForest.weight T (capacity b)
  r : I → ℤ
  c : J → ℤ
  X : I → J → ℤ
  d : ℕ
  W : ℕ
  hd : 1≤d
  hcard : Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J≤d
  hW : 2≤W
  hlarge : ∀ i j, small i j=false → W≤b i j ∧ 1≤b i j
  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W
  hX : ∀ i j, 0≤X i j ∧ X i j≤b i j
  hXr : ∀ i, (∑ j, X i j)=r i
  hXc : ∀ j, (∑ i, X i j)=c j

private lemma weight_transport {V U : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype U]
    (e : V≃U) (G : SimpleGraph V) (b : Sym2 V→ℕ) :
    weight (G.map e.toEmbedding) (fun a=>b (Sym2.map e.symm a))=weight G b := by
  rw [weight_eq,weight_eq,edgeFinset_map,Finset.sum_map]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  change b (Sym2.map e.symm (Sym2.map e a))=b a
  congr 1
  induction a using Sym2.inductionOn with
  | _ u v=>simp only [Sym2.map_mk,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

/-- A finite initial segment of an actual shortest-augmentation
execution. It need not already have reached a maximum flow. -/
noncomputable def path {G : SimpleGraph V} (S : Selection G) (v : V) : G.Walk v (S.root v) :=
  Classical.choice (S.reachable v)

def ResidualPath {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (f : Flow n) (s t : Fin n)
    (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) : Prop :=
  p 0=s ∧ p (Fin.last k)=t ∧ Function.Injective p ∧
  ∀ i : Fin k, 0<(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)

/-- An actual saturating augmentation along a shortest residual path.
The bottleneck is positive, bounded by every residual capacity, and
attained by an arc. The displayed update adds it forward and subtracts
it backward on precisely the traversed arcs. -/
structure Selection (G : SimpleGraph V) where
  root : V → V
  reachable : ∀ v,G.Reachable v (root v)
  constant : ∀ {u v},G.Reachable u v → root u=ro
